benchmarks.description: Compare thirteen product paths by single-core server throughput or cold-navigation browser cost without collapsing unlike measurements into one score.
benchmarks.methodology: 100 todos · 12 component types · 32 warm structural variants · current UTC state materialized per request · 64 connections from 2 load workers · 1 server process/worker pinned to 1 CPU · 7 × 10 s randomized rounds · dynamic SSR · natural bytes
benchmarks.metricSummary: WebUI / Rust / Actix records the highest median, 32.0% ahead of WebUI / Shadow DOM / Rust / Actix; the 341.2 req/s gap exceeds their combined 7.9 req/s MAD. Against the fastest non-WebUI row, React, WebUI / Rust / Actix is 148.2% higher; the 841.2 req/s gap exceeds their combined 18.1 req/s MAD.
